//: Tonwerk — the audio studio's own workbench. A separate app from Redaktion on purpose: Redaktion reads the checked-out corpus through @da/content and never opens a socket, while Tonwerk talks HTTP to a local render engine and holds a bearer token. They share the repository and nothing else — not a design system, not a transport, not a data layer. Everything it renders comes from `atlas-listening serve` on 127.0.0.1:8765; the only thing it imports from the workspace is the Scene v1 contract in @da/schema.
name: @da/tonwerk
